BestFriends_Merlin/Merlin_BestFriendsRec.en: That was quite a fascinating task, {PlayerName}. I hope this will meet your needs.

BestFriends_Merlin/Merlin_BestFriendsReq.en: Well yes, I suppose I could take a break from my research. Come back tomorrow, {PlayerName}, and I'll have your request fulfilled!

BestFriends_Merlin/Merlin_FTUE_Merl_BF_0.en: Splendid! You're here! I have some truly wonderful news, {PlayerName}.
As you've quite marvelously endeared yourself to all who reside in the Valley...
...many of your friends would like to assist you with the things you do — especially with <Lore>collecting items that you require</Lore>.
The Villagers can help me collect items?
That's so sweet!
I love teamwork.
Finally, a little help!
Well, you have more than earned the trust and adoration of us all!
Now, I suggest you <Lore>ask a Villager you're particularly close with</Lore> to help you collect something.
Someone who enjoys mining might help you find gems, a Villager who loves gardening might bring you fare from their garden, and a forager could, well... forage!
You only need ask, and I'm sure they will be happy to help and <Lore>have what you need by the next day</Lore>.
Yes, yes, it does often expedite things, doesn't it?
You do work very hard, my friend. And everyone knows that to be true.
Do find someone you are <Lore>very close friends with in the Village</Lore> and spend time with them, {PlayerName}.
While you're spending time with your closest friend, try collecting some minerals.
Would you show me what you collected during your time with your friend? It will assist me in my study of the power of friendship.
I knew it! My theories are correct!
With the magic of friendship, you now have the ability to <Lore>travel to your friend in an instant</Lore>!
And you can <Lore>ask them for help in finding items</Lore> and collect them the next day.
But the magic is even more powerful than that. If you activate that special <Lore>friendship glow</Lore> by spending time together, you'll be able to find more items AND glide without losing Energy.
Friendship is awesome!
I can't wait to make MORE friends here!
Who's YOUR best friend, Merlin?
That's the spirit, {PlayerName}!
Hmm, now let's see... Well, there's you, of course. And others in the Valley, many others. Also, a rather surly owl...
But that's a matter for another time.
{PlayerName}, I see that you've gotten help from a Villager in finding what you seek. Bravo!
Our last conversation made me quite curious about the nature of friendship and its magical properties. Connecting with others has mysterious power, especially here in Dreamlight Valley.
Now then, it would be of great help to me if you'd <Lore>spend time with one of your very closest Villager friends</Lore>. Then I can observe and study this phenomenon further.
If my theories are correct, you'll receive a special <Lore>magical glow</Lore> that will help you <Lore>move faster</Lore> and <Lore>collect more</Lore> while you're with that good friend!
